Treatment summary
Patient presented following a collision in which their vehicle was struck while the patient was turning left. Complaints
centered on low back pain with muscle guarding and reduced range of motion in the lumbar region. The mechanism
of injury and the force involved are consistent with the lumbar strain diagnosed. Imaging and physical examination
findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. The patient mentioned a minor strain to the same area several years
ago, which resolved completely without lasting limitation. Care was delivered over three visits, consisting of manual
therapy, guided stretching, and activity modification. Treatment followed a typical cuorse and was reduced in
frequency as symptoms improved. At the most recent visit the patient reported near-normal function with minimal
residual discomfort. Billing records reflect single charges for each service, with no duplicate or repeated entries.
Prognosis is good, with return to full activity anticipated and discharge from active care planned if improvement
continues.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
